title: Christa Pike is conscious and speaking after failed execution, attorneys say - The Washington Post
description: Tennessee tried and failed to execute her by lethal injection last week. She remains hospitalized.

title: France’s student protests highlight a debt crisis that could spill over to the rest of Europe - CNN
description: France’s unprecedented wave of student protests has laid bare the country’s growing financial pressures, which will only become more difficult to tackle as Europe’s second-largest economy tries to rein in a ballooning budget deficit.

title: Israel marks three years since Hamas-led 7 October 2023 attacks - BBC
description: About 1,200 people were killed and 251 others taken hostage during the assault. The Hamas-run health ministry in Gaza reports that more than 74,200 people have been killed in subsequent Israeli attacks.

title: Skydance To Make Paramount & Warner Bros. Lots Specialized, Each Housing Film Or TV/Streaming - Deadline
description: Skydance plans to make the Paramount and Warner Bros. lots specialized, one housing film and one housing TV and streaming, CEO David Ellison said.

title: Obama-era DOJ official to lead review of Cornell response to rape allegations - The Washington Post
description: University leaders may face a no-confidence vote by the Faculty Senate over their response to allegations of sexual assault on campus.
